data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: For 2019, Syndicate 1206 reported a net release of GBP 1.0m in prior year claims reserves. This was primarily driven by favourable developments on Property, Aviation, and Marine classes, partially offset by unfavourable developments across other classes. Due to the reinsurance to close of 2016 & Prior years at 31 December 2018, this development relates to the 2017 Year of Account.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes
partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is reported as a net (after reinsurance) improvement of GBP 1.0m in Note 9. A gross figure for overall prior year development was not explicitly stated. The claims development table on page 13 shows a net strengthening of GBP 6.883m for the 2017 Year of Account, which contradicts the narrative in Note 9; Note 9's wording on 'claims reserves established at the prior year end' was prioritized as more direct. The named events are modelled exposures for 2019, not actual incurred losses. The claims development table on page 13 only presents data for a single underwriting year (2017) and thus does not fit the standard multi-year claims triangle structure.
